title: Crystal Ball Oracle
description: A glowing crystal ball on a metallic stand contains a surreal scene with a translucent purple female profile made of glowing yellow neural-like branches facing a large green eye with a pink smile, also formed from branching veins. The sphere is filled with stars and nebula-like clouds against a dark blue background.
prompt: A mystical glowing crystal ball on a stand contains a surreal cosmic scene. Inside, a translucent hooded female profile in shades of purple is formed from glowing yellow branching neural veins, facing a large smiling green eye with a pink mouth, also composed of luminous branching structures. The orb is filled with stars, nebulae, and swirling purple and green energy against a deep space background.
